profile.headline: Web Developer at CableLabs
profile.summary:
I am an experienced and versatile Graphic Designer/Front-end Developer comfortable in executing both print and web-based projects from concept through finished project. My specialties include designing online and print marketing collateral [e-blasts, website layouts, banner ads, corporate event, sales promotional materials], logos, and corporate identity. Well-versed with the Adobe Suite including Premiere, After Effects, and Lightroom. Proficient in Html, CSS, SASS, Javascript, JQuery, GitHub, Bootstrap and Jira. 

I am a well-seasoned traveler, and believe that the colors, sites, and designs that I have observed in cities and natural habitats around the world contribute to new approaches and fresh concepts in my own work -- making me a stronger designer.

You can see my design portfolio at www.joygarcia.com.
